name: AI Chatbot – Free Sales & Support Assistant
author: Tu Tienda Online

sections.description:
Chatbot IA Gratis adds an AI-powered assistant to your site. It doesn’t just answer questions — it acts. When a visitor asks about a product, a service, or how to contact you, the assistant responds instantly and, if needed, takes them directly to the right page — product detail, pricing, contact form, or checkout.

One-click setup. No account to create. No credit card. Add your information once and the assistant uses it to respond on behalf of your business, 24 hours a day.

Why it converts more

Up to 7 out of 10 visitors leave when they can’t find what they’re looking for. The assistant catches them at the moment of doubt: answers the question on the spot, detects their intent, and guides them to the next step — so fewer visitors leave empty-handed.

Key features

  • Does more than answer — it acts — navigates visitors to the right page automatically; the chat reopens when they get there
  • AI trained on your business — add your products, policies, services and FAQs; the assistant uses your exact information to respond
  • One-click setup — connect your site and the widget appears instantly on every page, no coding required
  • Free plan included — 100 conversations per month, no credit card required
  • Pro & Business plans available — more conversations per month, upgrade directly from your WordPress dashboard
  • Matches your brand — set your welcome message and brand color
  • Enable / disable anytime — without deactivating the plugin
  • Bilingual admin panel — available in English and Spanish

How it works

  1. Activate the plugin and go to Chatbot IA in your WordPress sidebar
  2. Click Connect — your account is created automatically using your WordPress admin email
  3. Add information about your business in the knowledge base (products, services, policies, FAQs)
  4. The assistant starts responding to your visitors around the clock

External service

This plugin connects to the AI assistant service operated by Tu Tienda Online (https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app) to function. The connection is made only when you explicitly activate it from the settings panel. The service is used to:

  • Register your site and issue a unique API key on connection
  • Serve the chat widget JavaScript to your visitors
  • Process chat messages and generate AI responses

Data sent to the service includes your site URL, site name, and admin email (on connection), and visitor chat messages (during conversations). Review the privacy policy at https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app before connecting.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Go to Chatbot IA in your WordPress sidebar and click Connect.
  3. Add your business information in the knowledge base and customize the widget. Done.
sections.faq:
Do I need to create an account or enter a credit card?

No. When you connect your site, an account is created automatically using your WordPress admin email. The free plan requires no credit card.

Do I need an OpenAI API key or any other external service?

No. The AI is already included. You don’t need to sign up for or configure any external provider.

Will the chatbot slow down my site?

No. The widget loads asynchronously with no frameworks or heavy dependencies — it won’t affect your page speed or Core Web Vitals.

What language does the assistant respond in?

It responds based on what you write in the knowledge base. Write it in English, Spanish, or any other language and it will respond in that language.

What happens when I reach the free plan limit?

Once you hit 100 conversations for the month, the widget stops responding until the next month. Or upgrade to the Pro plan from the Chatbot IA settings page for more conversations.

Can I disable the chat temporarily?

Yes. Use the toggle in Chatbot IA → Settings to show or hide the widget without deactivating the plugin.

Is my data safe?

Chat messages are processed solely to generate responses and track usage. Review our privacy policy at https://asistente.tutiendaonline.app before connecting.

What languages is the admin panel available in?

English and Spanish. The plugin automatically uses the language set in your WordPress installation.
